prompts.title: Explain Like I'm Five
prompts.content:
Explain the following topic in very simple terms, as if you are speaking to a curious five-year-old. Use everyday analogies, short sentences, and avoid jargon.

Topic: [PASTE TOPIC HERE]
prompts.description: Turns any complex subject into a beginner-friendly explanation using simple analogies.

prompts.title: Meeting Notes Summarizer
prompts.content:
You are an executive assistant. Read the meeting transcript below and produce:
1. A 3-sentence executive summary
2. Key decisions (bulleted)
3. Action items with owner and due date
4. Open questions for the next meeting

Transcript:
[PASTE TRANSCRIPT HERE]
prompts.description: Turns raw meeting transcripts into a clean summary with decisions and action items.

prompts.title: Professional Email Rewrite
prompts.content:
Rewrite the email below to be clear, professional, and polite. Keep it under 120 words. Preserve the original intent and any specific dates or numbers.

Original email:
[PASTE EMAIL HERE]
prompts.description: Polishes a draft email into a concise, professional tone.

prompts.title: SWOT Analysis
prompts.content:
Act as a senior business analyst. Perform a SWOT analysis on the following subject. For each of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats, give 4 specific, evidence-based bullets. End with one strategic recommendation.

Subject: [PASTE COMPANY/PRODUCT/IDEA HERE]
prompts.description: Generates a structured SWOT with a closing strategic recommendation.

prompts.title: Root-Cause Analysis (5 Whys)
prompts.content:
Use the "5 Whys" technique on the problem below. Start with the symptom, then ask Why? five times in a row, going one level deeper each time. Finish with the most likely root cause and 2 corrective actions.

Problem: [DESCRIBE THE PROBLEM HERE]
prompts.description: Walks through the 5 Whys to surface the true root cause of an incident.

prompts.title: Compare and Contrast
prompts.content:
Compare and contrast the two items below across these dimensions: purpose, cost, ease of use, performance, and ideal user. Present the result as a Markdown table, then add a 2-sentence verdict on which is better and for whom.

Item A: [ITEM A]
Item B: [ITEM B]
prompts.description: Side-by-side comparison table plus a short verdict.

prompts.title: Code Review
prompts.content:
You are a senior software engineer doing a code review. Review the code below for: correctness, security issues, performance, readability, and missing tests. For each issue, quote the line, explain the risk, and suggest a concrete fix.

```
[PASTE CODE HERE]
```
prompts.description: Detailed code review covering correctness, security, performance and tests.

prompts.title: Explain This Code
prompts.content:
Explain what the following code does, step by step, as if teaching a junior developer. Identify inputs, outputs, side effects, and any non-obvious behavior. End with one suggested improvement.

```
[PASTE CODE HERE]
```
prompts.description: Walks through unfamiliar code line-by-line in plain English.

prompts.title: Generate Unit Tests
prompts.content:
Write a complete unit-test suite for the function below. Use the testing framework idiomatic to the language. Cover: the happy path, edge cases (empty/null/zero/very large), and at least one failure case. Include short comments explaining each test.

```
[PASTE FUNCTION HERE]
```
prompts.description: Produces a thorough unit-test suite with happy path, edge, and failure cases.

prompts.title: Debug This Error
prompts.content:
I am getting the following error. Diagnose the most likely cause, list 3 things I should check first, and suggest a corrected version of the relevant snippet.

Error message:
[PASTE ERROR]

Relevant code:
```
[PASTE CODE]
```
prompts.description: Walks through a stack trace and proposes the most likely fix.

prompts.title: Blog Post Outline
prompts.content:
You are an experienced content strategist. Create an outline for a 1,200-word blog post on the topic below. Include: a working title, a hook intro, 5 H2 sections (each with 2-3 H3 sub-points), a call-to-action, and 3 SEO keyword suggestions.

Topic: [PASTE TOPIC HERE]
Target audience: [DESCRIBE AUDIENCE]
prompts.description: Full SEO-aware blog outline ready to hand off to a writer.

prompts.title: Short Story Starter
prompts.content: Write the opening scene (around 300 words) of a short story in the [GENRE] genre. The protagonist is [CHARACTER]. The setting is [SETTING]. End the scene on a small cliffhanger that hints at the central conflict.
prompts.description: Produces a vivid 300-word opening scene with a built-in hook.

prompts.title: Social Media Caption Pack
prompts.content:
Generate 5 distinct social-media captions for the post described below. Provide one variant each: short and punchy, story-driven, question-based, list-style, and emoji-rich. For each, suggest 3 relevant hashtags.

Post description: [DESCRIBE THE POST]
Target platform: [PLATFORM]
prompts.description: Five caption variants in different styles, each with hashtag suggestions.

prompts.title: Lesson Plan (45 minutes)
prompts.content:
You are a curriculum designer. Build a 45-minute lesson plan on the topic below for [LEVEL] learners. Include:
- Learning objective (Bloom verb)
- Materials needed
- Hook activity (5 min)
- Direct instruction (15 min)
- Guided practice (15 min)
- Independent check (8 min)
- Exit ticket (2 min)

Topic: [PASTE TOPIC HERE]
prompts.description: Complete 45-minute lesson plan ready to use in a classroom.

prompts.title: Quiz Generator (10 questions)
prompts.content:
Create a 10-question quiz on the topic below for [LEVEL] learners. Mix: 6 multiple-choice (4 options each), 2 true/false, and 2 short-answer. For each question, mark the correct answer and add a one-sentence explanation.

Topic: [PASTE TOPIC HERE]
prompts.description: Mixed-format 10-question quiz with answer key and explanations.

prompts.title: Rubric Builder
prompts.content:
Design a 4-level grading rubric (Excellent / Proficient / Developing / Beginning) for the assignment described below. Use 4-5 evaluation criteria. For each criterion at each level, write a single descriptive sentence of what the work looks like.

Assignment: [DESCRIBE ASSIGNMENT]
prompts.description: Generates a clean 4-level rubric grid with descriptive language.

prompts.title: Differentiated Instruction
prompts.content: I am teaching the topic [TOPIC] to a class of mixed ability. Suggest 3 versions of the same activity tailored for: (a) struggling learners, (b) on-level learners, and (c) advanced learners. Each version should keep the same learning objective.
prompts.description: Three versions of one activity calibrated to different ability levels.
